question: Why must this teaching be carefully concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of men?
premises: The teaching is to be concealed.
The mortal world contains unworthy recipients.
inference: The verse commands guarded transmission of esoteric knowledge.
uncertainties: Exact social referent of narādhama is not specified.
plain_english: This must be carefully concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
